method: The listed brown rice quantity is the dry, uncooked weight. Follow the cooking and assembly steps below for this measured portion.

Start the 75g brown rice first: this is the uncooked weight. Use the water quantity and cooking time on the rice packet; simmer until tender, then drain if the packet method requires it. Keep covered briefly while finishing the pan, then serve immediately.

Deseed and dice the 90g red pepper and drain and rinse canned, ready-cooked kidney beans, then weigh out 90g; raw or dried kidney beans cannot be used in this method. Cut the 170g chicken breast into pieces no larger than 2cm on a separate board. Wash hands, the board and knife after handling the raw meat; do not rinse it.

Heat half the listed olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Add the chicken breast in one layer and cook for 10–12 minutes, turning regularly. Lower the heat if the outside browns too quickly. Check the centre with a clean food thermometer: it must reach 70°C for 2 minutes. Keep cooking if it has not reached that endpoint; the suggested time is a guide. Transfer to a clean plate; keep the pan for the vegetables. Never reuse the plate or utensils that held the raw food without washing them.

Add the remaining half of the listed olive oil to the same pan. Add 90g red pepper and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until softened with some bite. Keep the heat moderate so the small measured amount of oil does not smoke.
Add the drained kidney beans. Cover and heat for 3–4 minutes over a low heat, stirring halfway, until the beans are steaming hot.

Turn the heat to low and fold in the 40g harissa tomato sauce. Stir for 1–2 minutes until hot, following any longer heating instruction on the sauce label. This measured sauce coats the food; do not boil it dry or add an unlisted jar of sauce.

Return the cooked chicken breast and its juices to the pan and stir through. Heat gently until the whole pan is steaming hot, stirring to distribute the heat. Spoon the pan mixture over the freshly cooked rice. Serve immediately.
